tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Download current BillWatch deal data and filter by category, provider or plan. Returns US advertised base prices for streaming and VPN plans (listed prices, before taxes and extra fees). verified: true means the price was confirmed on the provider's official page within its freshness window. By defa

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Pricing changes over time for one BillWatch plan: dated snapshots of the listed monthly price and billing terms. Use search_deals to find plan ids.
